# Virtual Consultant Product Line - 1-Page Spec

## Product Vision
Create a scalable, AI-powered virtual consulting service for small and medium businesses (SMBs) focused on AI implementation, technical documentation, and SaaS optimization. Deliver high-value, personalized consulting through a hybrid human-AI model with AI agents handling 95% of routine work and human experts providing strategic oversight, corrections, and approvals.

## Core Offerings
1. **AI Implementation Consulting** - Help
